name: Ass Donkey
overview: The Bible presents the ass donkey as a valuable and versatile animal, integral to the daily life and prosperity of God's people. As seen in the patriarchal narratives, asses were commonly owned alongside sheep, oxen, and camels, serving practical roles such as riding and carrying burdens, exemplified by Abraham saddling his ass for his journey. The verses highlight their importance in transportation and labor, underscoring their role in God's provision and blessing upon His servants.
